title: Base-only ecosystem smokes reached Ice productivity science selection

failing_environment.observed: After the canonical scenario path repair, all nine release-targeted Factorio loads passed. Eight Base-only rows were then rejected because research_ice reported no_lab_compatible_science instead of stopping at its inactive Space Age boundary.

reproduction.observed: aai-containers, aai-industry, aai-loaders, big-mining-drill, equipment-gantry, FluidMustFlow, jetpack, and robot_attrition each loaded successfully with zero sanitation rows. Their research_ice diagnostic had status skipped, effects zero, lab_status missing-required, and reason no_lab_compatible_science. The Space Age biolabs-in-space row generated the stream with cryogenic science and passed.

root_cause.summary: Ice productivity was hidden without Space Age and required cryogenic science, but its stream specification did not declare required_mods. Factorio Base exposes enough ice authority for the generation requirement to pass, so Base-only compilation reached the deliberately unavailable cryogenic-science selector and emitted a misleading invalid-science observation.

repair_changes: declare space-age as an exact required mod for research_ice
retain cryogenic science as the required progression pack when Space Age is active
regress the explicit stream dependency in settings and compiler admission
record the package-visible diagnostic correction in the 3.2.5 changelog
regression_propositions: Base-only modsets skip research_ice as missing required mod space-age before science selection
Base-only release-targeted smokes produce no invalid_science_pack group for research_ice
Space Age still generates Ice productivity with cryogenic science and an accepting lab
the full release-targeted 2.1 ecosystem profile has zero unexpected grouped failures

closure.required: Base and Space Age compiler admission, deterministic package reconstruction, exact runtime.ecosystem pass, latest-head hosted gate, merge to dev, and fresh source-bound breadth closure
closure.boundary: This corrects development-package stream policy before source freeze. It does not assign C32, advance 3.2.5 beyond planned, create 2.5.5 authority, admit 3.3, or modify published distribution authority.
